sloka: व्यतिक्रम्य तु वेगेन गृहीत्वा दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ।सु भीमम् तन् महाअरण्यम् व्यतियातौ महाबलौ ॥३-६९-४॥
transliteration: vyatikramya tu vegena gṛhītvā dakṣiṇām diśam ।su bhīmam tan mahāaraṇyam vyatiyātau mahābalau ॥3-69-4॥

translations.english: The two mighty heroes swiftly forged through the great forest, which was an abode of serpents and lions.
